dataset: NHTSA Standing General Order (ADS) Deduplicated Crashes — Monthly Summary
source: NHTSA Standing General Order 2021-01 ADS incident reports
coverage: United States — ADS reports under SGO 2021-01
notes: One crash per NHTSA Same Incident ID. Multiple Report IDs for the same real-world crash are counted once. Counts are grouped by incident month, not filing month. Records without a Same Incident ID fall back to Report ID and are explicitly counted below.
